instruction.text: International tourism is extremely popular nowadays, with millions of people travelling to experience other countries.

atoms.a: How many tourists do you think travel internationally each year?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Some of the most famous and most visited sights for international tourists are The Seven Wonders of the World. These are a collection of the world’s most extraordinary man-made landmarks.
These monuments are located all over the world, from the Taj Mahal in India to Machu Picchu in Peru. Some people even set themselves the task of visiting all seven!

atoms.a: What are the Seven Wonders of the World?
b: a group of famous explorers and their pets
a large area of ordinary buildings around the world

atoms.a: Which monuments are among the Seven Wonders of the World?

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: What do you think mass tourism is?

b.sound: tourism on a large scale, where many people visit the same place at the same time
multiple people moving house permanently to a new location

feedback.end: Mass tourism is usually quite cheap and is often sold as a package holiday.

instruction.text: Select “BUY NOW” to learn more about package holidays.

atoms.b: Package holidays are pre-planned holidays organised by a travel ((++company pet)), who sell multiple services all packaged together.
These services usually include flights, accommodation and even activities, making holiday planning ((harder ++easier)) for customers.
Because of this, package holidays are often a popular option amongst ((++families astronauts)).
